items.q: What can an agent actually do?
items.a: It answers your clients on a chat link or a widget on your site, searches the documents you upload, researches the web with citations, drafts posts and emails, logs bugs and requests, and schedules its own follow-ups. It can work on a schedule or the moment someone writes in.

items.q: Will it ever send something I haven't seen?
items.a: No. Every agent starts in draft-only mode, so posts and emails wait for your approval in the Inbox. You can loosen that per agent and per tool once one has earned it.

items.q: What happens if an agent gets it wrong?
items.a: You catch it in the inbox, because the draft is the thing you approve: reject it, or edit it and send the version you want. Every agent also has an escalation rule that stops it and brings in a person, and the audit log shows what it did and which sources it used.

items.q: Where do its answers come from?
items.a: From the documents you upload (PDF, Word, Markdown, text) and from cited web pages. When the answer is in neither, the agent says it doesn't know rather than inventing one.

Nothing you upload is used to train an AI model, and your documents are readable only inside your organisation. Integration credentials such as API keys are encrypted at rest with AES-256-GCM. TODO: confirm the hosting, backup and deletion details you want stated here before launch.

items.q: Can I connect my own tools?
items.a: Today an agent can send email through your own Resend account, post notifications to Slack or any webhook, take work in through an inbound webhook, and talk to clients through a hosted link or the embed widget. Direct Gmail, LinkedIn and Slack posting are not built yet.
About five minutes: pick a role, upload a document, test it live in the playground, publish. The app has a step-by-step guide for each part, from hiring an agent to reading the audit log.

items.q: Do you have a plan for a bigger team?
items.a: Every plan already includes unlimited teammates, with roles and invitations. If you need more agents, more volume, or a security review before you can buy, get in touch and we'll size it with you.

items.q: What languages does it work in?
items.a: An agent reads your documents and replies in the language you write its job in, and the models behind it handle the major languages well. The Desker interface itself is English only today. TODO: confirm the language list you want to state before launch.
